purpose: Murphy/DeGroot-Fienberg decomposition of the multiclass Brier score for the entanglement ablation. Answers whether the ring trades refinement for calibration, which Section 8.3 previously inferred from the sign of ECE rather than measured. Forecasts are grouped by k-means on the simplex and the reconstruction residual is reported, because the decomposition identity is exact only for identical forecast vectors.

protocol.grouping: k-means on the predicted probability vector
protocol.note: 7-qubit runs drop the constant prior_risk channel (channel 8), which is identically zero across all splits.
